# CBRE Expands Critical Infrastructure Capabilities in Europe and Asia Pacific with Onnec Acquisition


October 20, 2026 7:00 am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_9fc126ae7c09a4841cb52d0213e70f57/cbre/news/2026-10-20_CBRE_Expands_Critical_Infrastructure_Capabilities__270.pdf)


DALLAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE: CBRE) today announced a definitive agreement to acquire Onnec Group Limited, a leading provider of data center infrastructure services for the world’s largest technology companies in Europe and Asia Pacific. The acquisition will significantly enhance CBRE’s ability to support its clients’ data center needs on a global basis.


The initial purchase price is £460 million (approximately $610 million) in cash. In addition, the parties have agreed to a multi-year earnout of up to £300 million (approximately $400 million), subject to Onnec meeting certain growth thresholds. Onnec is expected to generate approximately £370 million ($498 million) in revenue and more than £50 million ($67 million) of core EBITDA in 2027 and be immediately accretive to CBRE’s core earnings per share.


Onnec will operate as part of CBRE’s Critical Infrastructure Services line of business. CBRE expects this business line to generate nearly $4.5 billion of total revenue in 2027, including contributions from Onnec. The rest of CBRE’s services businesses, most notably Project Management and Advisory Services, are expected to generate almost $2.5 billion of infrastructure services revenue in 2027, resulting in total estimated 2027 infrastructure services revenue of nearly $7.0 billion. This does not include revenue from periodic data center land sales in the development business.


Founded in 1986 and based in London, Onnec specializes in the design, deployment and maintenance of network, fiber and data center infrastructure. The company’s approximately 800 employees serve hyperscalers across key markets in the United Kingdom, Continental Europe and Asia Pacific. Onnec’s geographic presence aligns well with the data center infrastructure services that CBRE delivers in the United States.


“CBRE is pursuing an explicit strategy to build a global infrastructure services business to complement our real estate services business. We’ve long believed Onnec is an excellent fit in this strategy,” said Vikram Kohli, CBRE’s Chief Operating Officer. “The acquisition is also consistent with our ongoing effort to build resilient businesses that benefit from secular tailwinds.”


Barry Horgan, Chairman of Onnec, said, “From day one, our focus has been on delivering exceptional connectivity solutions for our customers. As part of CBRE, we gain the platform and expertise to broaden our capabilities, creating even greater value for our clients, and provide new opportunities for our employees, while staying true to the customer-focused approach that has driven our success.”


The Onnec transaction is subject to customary regulatory approvals and is expected to be completed around the end of the year.


J.P. Morgan Securities, LLC is acting as financial advisor and Simpson, Thacher & Bartlett LLP as legal advisor to CBRE. Goldman Sachs International is acting as financial advisor and Freshfields LLP as legal advisor to Onnec.


About CBRE Group, Inc.


CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE:CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm (based on 2025 revenue) and a premier provider of critical infrastructure services. The company has more than 155,000 employees serving clients in more than 100 countries. CBRE serves clients through four business segments: Advisory (leasing, sales, debt origination, mortgage servicing, valuations); Building Operations & Experience (facilities management, property management, flex space & experience, critical infrastructure); Project Management (program management, project management, cost consulting); Real Estate Investments (investment management, development). Please visit our website at[www.cbre.com](http://www.cbre.com/) . We routinely post important information on our website, including corporate and investor presentations and financial information. We intend to use our website as a means of disclosing material, non-public information and for complying with our disclosure obligations under Regulation FD. Such disclosures will be included in the Investor Relations section of our website at[https://ir.cbre.com](https://ir.cbre.com/) . Accordingly, investors should monitor such portion of our website, in addition to following our press releases, Securities and Exchange Commission filings and public conference calls and webcasts.


About Onnec


Onnec is a leading independent global IT infrastructure solutions and services partner, specializing in providing end-to-end connectivity solutions for data center, office, fulfilment center and other environments. From structured cabling, managed services and networking, our end-to-end services give you the infrastructure you can completely rely on. Onnec is one of the world’s leading exponents in this space and, with approximately 800 full-time employees across EMEA, US and APAC, the company is structured around key global customers to ensure consistency of service and delivery. As such, the company has a loyal customer base of leading businesses with many relationships spanning more than 30 years. Customers benefit from decades of experience and industry-leading standards – deployed at a local level. Onnec is at the center of connections, and strong connections is at the heart of everything Onnec does.
